facts: Cucumber loads Ruby step definitions from features/step_definitions/. Use Given, When or Then with a regular expression or Cucumber Expression and a Ruby block. The keyword does not distinguish definitions when matching a step.

Captured expression parameters become block arguments. A step DocString or DataTable adds its native multiline argument after the captures. Background steps execute before the scenario and need definitions too.

Per-scenario state is held on Cucumber World, including Ruby instance variables. Retained features/support/ files provide the Rails and Capybara setup, lifecycle hooks, route paths, selectors, sections and World helpers. Do not replace those files.
Use the retained RSpec expectations and Capybara rack_test integration to exercise the Rails application. Production code under app/ and lib/ is never accepted as a submission.

The retained spec/factories.rb supplies FactoryBot factories; spec/support/ supplies shared support. Scenario fixtures and recorded VCR responses remain under spec/fixtures/. The constituency API is stubbed by retained hooks.
The admitted scenario set excludes inherited or scenario-level @wip and @javascript tags. Eligible scenarios run in process with rack_test; no browser or external network is available.

The evaluator image provides Ruby 3.2.11, Cucumber 11.1.1, bundled gems, Node dependencies and a private PostgreSQL 16 database with pgvector. Retained hooks rebuild assets at boot. Do not install dependencies or change database configuration.

Put Ruby files under features/step_definitions/**, creating the directory if needed. The entire original directory was removed, including helpers and generated web_steps.rb, email_steps.rb and pickle_steps.rb boilerplate. Some boilerplate may be reproducible from public gem documentation; the retained env.rb is also generated cucumber-rails support.

Generation is final-only. You may read, search and edit the permitted repository view and use syntax tools. It is a provisioned application runtime for the code in `./repo`. The harness evaluates the final submitted tests against the separate complete application after generation ends. You receive no harness execution feedback during generation.
TARGET_CONTRACTS.md contains the reviewed public API, route, configuration and resource contracts supplied consistently in every visibility setting; edits to it are not submitted.
Implementation visibility: reviewed target bodies and their behavior-implementing delegation are hidden; public contracts and permitted surrounding code remain visible.
environment.platform: the UK Parliament e-petitions Rails application (Ruby 3.2.11, Cucumber 11.1.1, PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector)
environment.retained: the retained features/support/ hooks and World helpers, spec/support/, spec/factories.rb and spec/fixtures/ inputs

rules: Only files under `repo/features/step_definitions/` are accepted. Repo-wide removal deleted those directories, so create whatever path you need; `features/support/`, `spec/support/`, `spec/factories.rb` and `spec/fixtures/` remain.
Production code is never accepted. Anything you change outside `repo/features/step_definitions/` is discarded.

In order to see what petitions were created in the past
  As Joe, a member of the general public
  I want to be able to view all archived petitions
feature.title: Joe views all archived petition

scenario.gherkin:
Scenario: Downloading the CSV data for archived petitions
    Given I am on the archived petitions page
    Then I should see the following list of archived petitions:
      | Wombles are great         | Total signatures 835       |
      | Common People             | Total signatures 639       |
      | Save the planet           | Total signatures 243       |
      | Wombles to Parliament     | Total signatures 243       |
      | Free gig tickets          | Rejected on 8 January 2013 |
    And the markup should be valid
    When I click the CSV link
    Then I should get a download with the filename "filtered-archived-petitions.csv"
scenario.title: Downloading the CSV data for archived petitions
